title.full: What IP riders are and what to consider

summary.text: IP riders cover part of your plan's deductible and co-insurance. Consider co-payment, extra benefits, and if you can afford long-term costs.

details.heading: What riders do
details.body: IP riders are optional products designed to cover part of the deductible and co-insurance of your Integrated Shield Plan (IP). Even with a rider, patients will still need to co-pay a minimum of 5% of the claimable amount. Riders may also provide coverage for additional treatments, such as cancer drug treatments not covered under MediShield Life and IPs.

details.heading: Things to consider
details.body: Consider whether you are willing to pay more premiums to lower your co-pay. Check if extra benefits like pre-hospitalisation or TCM are worth the cost. Most importantly, think about whether you can afford the premiums as they increase when you age.
